notes: REF-BM-06: duplicate url is blocked server-side (409 + existingBookmarkId) but the UI only shows an error message and never opens/edits the existing bookmark, so it does not converge to editing. REF-BM-10: a ranked tag-suggestion endpoint (/api/tags) exists but the web tag input is a plain comma field that never calls it, so no autocomplete is offered. REF-BM-20: multi-select works but bulk actions are limited to addTag/archive/delete; remove-tag and read/unread bulk actions are not implemented. REF-BM-23: markdown notes are stored and editable but rendered as plain text (no markdown library or rendering). REF-BM-24: snapshot is a PNG page screenshot, not a local single-file HTML capture, and the PDF-download rule is not implemented. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/wayback integration. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: preferences persist only theme and density; default sort, font size, and displayed-items count are not adjustable/persisted.
